items.question: By what numerical scope must the suffering of those beings be understood to hold within the womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four is set within thousands of womb-diagrams.
The beings in question fall under that numerical scope.
That scope marks the extent of their tormented state.
items.inference: The torment applies to those beings across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the tormented beings remains unmarked by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
